card.name: Noun-forming endings like -ization
card.fires_on: The ending of abstract nouns and participles built from a stem, mostly -ization, -ized, -ity, in academic or political prose. Also fires on a few abstract nouns like randomness.

modes.label: -ization endings
modes.description: The -ization ending after a stem such as collectiv, liberal, modern or individual.

modes.label: -ized and -ity endings
modes.description: Participle or noun endings completing words like standardized, localized, periodicity.

modes.label: Abstract noun after the
modes.description: An abstract noun like randomness following a determiner in a list of technical sources.
